subject.title: fix(gateway): recover when suppressed channel secrets are unavailable

question: Should crash-loop safe mode let `secrets.reload` automatically restart only affected accounts that were already running, or should this bug fix remain limited to startup SecretRef projection and require explicit channel recovery?
rationale: Both open PRs fix the reported startup ordering regression, but this branch additionally replaces an established operator-visible safe-mode reload policy; code inspection alone cannot determine which permanent recovery contract maintainers intend.

options.title: Split startup from reload policy
options.body: Land the source/assignment startup fix first and decide account-aware safe-mode reload recovery in a focused follow-up with dedicated service proof.

options.title: Adopt account-aware recovery now
options.body: Keep this PR's restart and rollback contract after an owner verifies exact-head proof for every relevant account lifecycle state.

options.title: Keep explicit recovery
options.body: Choose the narrower candidate and continue requiring an explicit channel start or Gateway restart after credential repair.

recommendation.title: Split startup from reload policy
recommendation.body: Land the source/assignment startup fix first and decide account-aware safe-mode reload recovery in a focused follow-up with dedicated service proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their earlier work introduced the adjacent `secrets.reload` channel-restart behavior whose safe-mode semantics are being changed.
